scaledCalls: All plan positions are SCALED: read as pixel positions on the 1/2 in = 1 ft A513/A514 split PNGs (2576 px wide sheet, 35.8 px per ft) and mapped linearly onto the A100 room wall extents, which are MEASURED. Room widths read back within 0.2 ft of the A100 values on both sheets.

Servery counter V band 45.05-48.20 scaled from A514; its U extent is taken as wall to wall because PA-802.1 (246 1/4 in) equals the room length and the RK note says it is sandwiched between two walls.
Upper hutch of the large servery put on the service (high V) edge of the base: the sections show an 18 in deep upper on one side of the 36 in base but do not say which side.

Breakfast bar hutch and refrigerator bay put at the low-U end: A514 tags refrigerator 31 at the low-U end and the PA-802.2 front view shows the refrigerator bay under the hutch at one end; the 49 in food-warmer cutout is then measured from the high-U end.
Counter-top appliance footprints (items 23-30) scaled from the A514 symbols because the Clevenger cut-sheet package (17 MB) is over the Drive download limit; heights left null rather than guessed.
Food prep fixture footprints (03, 04, 08, 13, 14, 18, 19, 22, 10) scaled from the A513 symbols; heights null.
Wall-mounted shelves (06, 07, 12, 15, 17) given the placement of the fixture they hang over; no sizes.
gaps: No dining tables or chairs are drawn inside Breakfast 006 on ID-1.7 or A514: the room holds only the servery counter and the breakfast bar. Guest dining (PA-300/301/302 tables, PA-101/102/106 chairs, PA-100 banquette, PA-800 perch table with PA-107 stools) sits in Lobby 003 and belongs to the lobby kit. The DB rows PA-309 and PA-110 (6) at 006 are the Employee Breakroom 014 table and chairs (ID-1.7 tags them at U about 187-190 in 014).

Clevenger Associates food service cut sheets (Drive 1sB5dT7US2uvLB4-LpSRgKpzHZ28nNZfE, 17 MB) could not be downloaded (over the 10 MB tool limit), so no measured sizes for the waffle makers, toaster, showcase, juice dispenser, kettle, cereal dispenser, coffee maker, microwave, hand sink, worktop refrigerator, work table or shelving.

A514 tag 34 on the breakfast bar (leader to the bay just right of the refrigerator, about U 173.9) and tag 39 (the round item in the 12 in cutout) have no schedule row; 39 is taken as the A902 yogurt machine. 34 is not placed.

Dish recovery / bussing counter M5 (A901.1, 4'-6" x 2'-0" x 2'-10") is not drawn on ID-1.7 or A514 inside the room; dimensions recorded, no placement. PA-804 Trash and Recycling is tagged on ID-1.7 outside the room in the corridor by the restrooms (lobby kit).

Speed rack 21 (Cres Cor 207-UA-13A) and the walk-in items 02, 11, 32, 33 are on A513 but not inside the 007 crop or not in this kit (walk-in is in Dry Storage 008). Reach-in display freezer 35 and refrigerator 36 (A514 electrical schedule only; submittals DSM-41R and D12-B) and the two Vivreau water dispensers 37 are not drawn in 006/009/007 (Market 005 and the PA-803 hydration station are the likely homes).
Heights for the worktop refrigerator, sinks, work table and counter-top appliances are not in any reached source and are left null.

Model variance on record: A513 schedules dishmachine Champion UH-100B and oven Moffat E33D5H2; the approved submittals are H50-ST and Moffat E27M3 on an SK2731U stand. Dimensions here follow the submittals.
